title: Model Field Pulse: Micro-market Rapid Recon & Competitive Signal Toolkit
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Define and deliver a lightweight playbook + templated telemetry queries to run 2-week micro-market recon missions that capture: regional model availability, latency tail behavior for embeddings/generation, short-run price arbitrage signals, and early adoption indicators from customer telemetry and partner marketplaces.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook doc with step-by-step queries and checklist is published in Confluence; 2) 3x templated dashboards (US, EU, APAC) are available in the intelligence Looker folder; 3) Two pilot recon missions completed and writeups surfaced to sales and SRE; 4) Signal ingestion pipeline for availability flags created and merged (PR reference in attachments).
notes: Rationale: Existing model-watch activities are high-fidelity but slow. This ticket focuses on a nimble recon that product, SRE, and AE teams can run with minimal engineering support.

Target signals: availability (endpoint/region), 95/99th token-latency for short prompts, embedp/sec throughput, on-call incident frequency for model provider, price-per-inference delta from public docs.
Trade-offs: Lower sample fidelity vs turnaround time. Use synthetic probes + sampled customer telemetry rather than full-scale load tests for speed.
Risk: Public provider rate limits could bias availability measurement; mitigation: rotate IPs and aggregate over windows and partner data.
Stakeholders: Product (Lead: Elena), Solutions Eng (liaison: Priya Nair), SRE (liaison: Tom O'Neill), Sales Ops (liaison: Jonah Park).
decisions: Use 30s probing cadence for availability checks to balance cost and signal freshness.
Focus first-pass on text-generation and embeddings; delay multimodal probes to a follow-up sprint.
Store raw probe logs in a short-lived bucket (30 days), surface aggregated flags to the Signal Hub for longer retention.
